blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The local government of Cajidiocan in Romblon has suspended classes in all public elementary and secondary schools on Oct. 5 in observance of National Teachers’ Day and World Teachers’ Day. The suspension also covers work for teaching and non-teaching personnel in public schools, according to Executive Order No. 073, series of 2026, issued by Mayor Marvin R. Ramos. READ: 8 hurt, including 6 students, in Romblon road crash The order provides school personnel an opportunity to participate in activities marking the annual celebration honoring teachers and recognizing their contribution to education. /jpv...
